# Pitch Trajectory

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchTrajectory`](gmeow-PitchTrajectory.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchTrajectory>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

Continuous pitch as content — an ordered set of control points (musical-time × [`PitchValue`](gmeow-PitchValue.md)) plus an interpolation kind. Models glissandi, gamaka ornaments, UPIC curves, and other continuously varying pitch (stress case 6). Interpolation is solver-evaluated, never reasoner-asserted ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
